name: Cratoavis
sum: Enantiornithine from the Crato Formation of Ceará, Brazil, preserved with feathers.
holotype: An articulated skeleton with attached feathers from the Araripe Basin (number in Carvalho et al. 2015).
biology: Remains of at least two Dastilbe fish lie where the gut would be, suggesting it ate fish.
author: Carvalho et al. 2015
